notes.title: Puzzle game Pixross from Kenney is free for 24 hours
notes.content:
Act fast if you want to get a good free puzzle game! Kenney is giving away Pixross on itch.io and it has Native Linux support.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2022/07/puzzle-game-pixross-from-kenney-is-free-for-24-hours

notes.title: Update version 1.4.0
notes.content:
Pixross has been updated! Thanks to your feedback we've added the following features, or made changes to the game:

[list]
[*] [b]Added 10 plant themed puzzles[/b]
[*] [b]Added 3 plant themed backgrounds[/b]
[*] [b]Added 2 Halloween themed backgrounds[/b]
[*] [b]Added option to hide puzzle thumbnails[/b]
[*] [b]Fixed issues displaying percentage of unlocked customizations[/b]
[*] [b]All puzzles have been checked for logic solving (see below)[/b]
[/list]

[b]The following puzzles have been improved and/or fixed;[/b]

Art, Ballet, Bat, Bug, Fishing, Gecko, Headphones, Hot Dog, Jellyfish, Kite, Liberty, Lumberjack, Octopus, Office, Pine, Pottery, Proposal, Sleigh, Star, Tic-Tac-Toe, Truck, Umbrella and Vine.

Again, thanks for your feedback and reviews - all of these features were added after being requested by players. Stay tuned for more updates in the near future!

notes.title: Update version 1.3.0
notes.content:
Pixross has been updated! Thanks to your feedback we've added the following features, or made changes to the game:

[list]
[*] [b]Added 10 new (15×15) puzzles[/b]
[*] [b]Added random size option for randomly generated puzzles[/b]
[*] [b]Added switch between drawing modes during gameplay[/b] (see below)
[*] [b]Added 6 new styles[/b] (3 tile styles, 3 backgrounds)
[*] [b]Improve line drawing[/b] (see below)
[*] [b]Menu screen now lists percentage of unlocked styles[/b]
[*] [b]Styles dialog now shows from what category has been unlocked[/b]
[*] [b]The gashapon machine is now slightly faster[/b]
[*] [b]Added 🥕[/b]
[/list]

[b]Switching drawing modes[/b]

You can press spacebar to switch between free draw and line mode, you can also hold shift (left or right) to temporarily switch. The option you select in the options menu will be the default mode when starting a puzzle.

[b]Improve line drawing[/b]

The game will now always attempt to draw tiles in a line whether your mouse cursor is near the line or not. It'll also stick the tile selector to the line column or row.

Again, thanks for your feedback and reviews - all of these features were added after being requested by players. Stay tuned for more updates in the near future!

notes.title: Update version 1.2.1
notes.content:
Pixross has been updated! Thanks to your feedback we've made a few changes and fixed some bugs, especially related to the 'no penalty' manual mode:

[list]
[*][b]Improved drawing controls in 'no penalties' mode[/b] [i](see below)[/i]
[*][b]Improved visual of clue selector outline[/b]
[*][b]Fixed issue related to clue completing in 'no penalties' mode[/b]
[/list]

[b]Improved drawing controls[/b]

From user feedback we gathered that drawing either a tile or a mark (cross) shouldn't overwrite what's already on the board, more so when either drawing or deleting it should *only* draw or delete but not override other parts of the board.

Again, thanks for your feedback and reviews - all of these improvements were done after being requested by players. Stay tuned for more updates in the near future!

notes.title: Update version 1.2
notes.content:
Pixross has been updated! Thanks to your feedback we've added the following features, or made changes to the game:

[list]
[*][b]Removed feedback when penalties disabled[/b] — No feedback or penalties
[*][b]Added random puzzle generation (5×5, 10×10 and 15×15)[/b]
[*][b]Added ability to pan puzzle[/b] — plus an option to reverse controls
[*][b]Added two new Steam achievements[/b] — completing 100, and 150 puzzles
[/list]

Again, thanks for your feedback and reviews - all of these features were added after being requested by players. Stay tuned for more updates in the near future!

notes.title: Great nonogram puzzler Pixross from Kenney is now on Steam and upgraded
notes.content:
After releasing for itch.io first Pixross, the nonogram puzzle game from Kenney, has now hopped on over to Steam and it also had a sweet upgrade for both stores.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2020/12/great-nonogram-puzzler-pixross-from-kenney-is-now-on-steam-and-upgraded
